guest.headline: Well, I did make a list.
guest.body: Create a wish list and share it with friends and family. They can choose and reserve a gift without creating an account.
guest.createHint: You’ll need an account to create a wish list.
guest.selfHost: Want to host Oh, You Shouldn't! yourself?

mine.title: My wish lists
mine.emptyBody: Gather your gift ideas, then share them with friends and family.

newList.title: Create a wish list
newList.description: Name your wish list, add a first category, and choose who the gifts are for. You can add more categories and recipients later.
newList.categoryHint: Categories help you organize your gift ideas.
newList.personPlaceholder: e.g. Alex, Sam, Both of us
newList.personHint: Enter a person or a group, such as “Both of us”.
